posts.headline: One Nut Barner is now twenty-two straight editions into total radio silence, and this league needs to ask why a 20-8 career mark with a 1.5 average finish and zero rings has never once made him say a word.
posts.detail: Put it in Ra owns the best career record AND the best average finish in Busters Anonymous history — a 1.5! — yet has exactly zero titles to show for it, and the silence in the face of that stat is deafening.

posts.headline: Sasinci's World enters the draft still needing to explain how a championship banner sits on top of a losing 13-15 career record.
posts.detail: Big Head can quit the league threats for now, but he can't quit math — one title, a 5.5 average finish, and a losing record is the strangest résumé for a reigning-tier contender this league has ever seen.

posts.headline: talentedtenthh gets a fresh roster this preseason, but the untalented tenth doesn't get a fresh reputation.
posts.detail: A 4-10 record and a dead-last 12th-place finish in his only season is the floor of this entire league, and nothing in the draft room erases that until Chauncey actually wins something.

posts.headline: SwooshAnoosh is about to draft his way into another season, and this league still has zero reason to believe the Prince of Persia escapes the basement.
posts.detail: An 11th-place finish and a 5-9 record in his debut season is exactly the kind of résumé that gets you picked last in every mock draft conversation at the bar.

posts.headline: Thicks is one draft away from finding out if #FreeMaxx Champions was a real dynasty or a two-season mirage.
posts.detail: A 14-14 career record and a 5.5 average finish underneath that championship banner means the pressure is all on Tyrique14 to prove the ring wasn't a fluke before a single game is even played.
